crons.description: IFRS 16 monthly journal: depreciation + interest + principal for all active leases
Recurring billing: generate due invoices with pro-rating
FX Revaluation (IAS 21): unrealized G/L at month-end closing rate
Document expiry: flag expired contracts, licenses, insurance policies
Daily audit digest: summarize AuditLog entries for overnight review
Weekly payment reminders: send dunning notices for overdue AR
Approval SLA check: escalate overdue, send reminders, auto-approve leaves
ZATCA batch: auto-submit pending B2B clearance + B2C reporting invoices every 15 min
Fixed assets depreciation (IAS 16): compute + post monthly GL journal for all tenants on day 1
Payroll GL auto-post: after approved payroll, post Dr Salary Expense / Cr Salary Payable journal on day 28
AR Collection Dunning: weekly escalation of overdue invoices through 4 dunning levels, credit hold on L2+, Telegram report
VAT Return Reminder: day 20 of each month — estimates VAT payable, sends Telegram + Notification with deadline countdown
Prepayments Monthly Amortization: day 1 of each month at 5AM — auto-amortizes all active prepaid entries (Dr Expense / Cr Prepaid), decrements remainingMonths, marks COMPLETED when done
